News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.0.0
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.0 is finally here!
<size=105%>Crewmate:</size>
- Vanisher - fixed bug where players were unable to use the Vanish button
- Falcon - replaced zoom in/out button icons with a single one
- Bodyguard - added sacrifice animation in meetings, fixed being able to kill the protected player, improved shield and nameplate marker rendering
- Evoker - fixed inability to click map/tasks/doors during blind and fixed global verification limit per game not being respected
- Vampire Hunter - fixed incorrectly granting crewmate power and protective
- President - definitive fix for vote bank system, added tutorial image, fixed banner visibility
<size=105%>Neutral:</size>
- Pelican - complete rework: added swallow counter, fixed Investigator footprints, fixed huge range, fixed anti-cheat kicks during digestion, restored UI refresh after death, fixed instant ghost bug
- Doppelganger - fixed kill button cooldown not decreasing while in vents
- Shroud - fixed marker visibility and placement logic
- Lawyer - reworked Objection: now shows your own character, added sound fade-out, fixed client marker visibility
- Pirate - added tutorial image, fixed ties counting as win, fixed button blocking during duel
- Bounty Hunter - added target counter, fixed target marker refresh and visibility bug
- Pope - fixed win condition, added Spellslinger death animation, fixed screen flashing during meetings, added marker visibility
- Shifter - fixed Assassin modifier exploit for Amnesiacs
<size=105%>Impostor:</size>
- Kamikaze - fixed kill detection, reworked explosion radius to use RC-XD light scaling, changed sphere color to orange, added round 1 suicide protection
- Wraith - fixed lantern visibility bug and added a small delay to ensure Swooper modifier applies before teleporting
- Poisoner - added poison body animation, fixed poisoned players not dying in meetings
- Witch - fixed curse marker rendering and visibility
- Outlaw - fixed kill button
- RC-XD - improved car rendering and sync, fixed body/shield/target marker persistence
<size=105%>Modifiers & Mechanics:</size>
- Death Note - fixed numerous bugs and improved overall stability
- Guessing System - Venomous and Death Note are now guessable based on their individual toggles
- Lovers - added toggle option for Lover Chat during meetings
<size=105%>Game Modes & UI:</size>

- Draft Mode - complete system overhaul with polished UI, added Random Neutral (70/15/15 logic), added Legacy Mode (picking from all classes) and Respect Role Chances, fixed spectators being included in pick order
- Localization - added Full Polish Support with Local Settings toggle
- Lobby Options - significant reorganization and rework of many option groups
<size=105%>Other:</size>
- Wiki Overhaul - added detailed terminology with new icons (Lawyer, Medic, Jackal, Shield Flashes)
- Wiki Settings - added Hacker icon and real-time display for Draft Mode
- Fixed Crewmate abilities (Evoker, Falcon, Mirage, etc.) not working during communications sabotage
- Cleaned up redundant RPC calls and improved Host-side synchronization
- Optimized mod size (36MB -> 14MB)
- Most importantly: fixed old bugs and added new ones!

News.SubTitle: Shield Rework & Polish
News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.0.2
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.2 - Shield Rework & Banger Polish
<size=105%>Major Improvements & Optimizations:</size>

- Serial Killer - FIXED Kill-from-Vent (Final). Implemented Escape Usages system: after a vent kill, you get 1 extra vent use to escape. Fixed 1v1 Venting endgame block and added Kill Cooldown Reduction (toggle option).
- Pelican - FIXED Shield Bypass. Pelican now correctly respects all protections (Medic, Bodyguard, etc.) and follows the Juggernaut button layout.
- Vulture - MASSIVE FPS optimization for Scavenge and Eat (fixed expensive object searches). Finalized button layout.
- Evoker - MASSIVE FPS optimization (fixed update loop). Added New Option: Blind Type and polished effects.
- Outlaw - fixed bonus kill window (second kill) and synchronized modded cooldown with vanilla UI.
- President - fixed Vote Bank reset bug (removed broken Infinite option), range is now 1-20.
- Poisoner - implemented "Zerkaa-style" layout and added Flicker Banger button shake effect.
<size=105%>Button Layouts & UI:</size>
- Bodyguard - Full Color Rework. Role, Symbols, and Shield Flashes are now Sky Blue (#4DA6FF) for better visibility.
- Shroud - Fixed buggy button layout to match Vulture order. Killing no longer cancels Shrouded status on victims.
- Ventable Modifier - added Uses Left counter and Blinking Effect for the last 3 seconds of vent duration.
- UI Optimization - Fixed sibling indexing for multi-button roles to support 'Offset Buttons' mode.
<size=105%>Shield System & CD Rework:</size>
- Custom Save Cooldowns - Hitting shields now gives specific cooldowns: Mirror Caster (FULL CD), Bodyguard (10s), Cleric/FirstRound (5s), Warden (1s).
- First Round Shield - Now persists after being hit to provide continuous protection.
- Interaction Differentiation - Deadly Quota allows targeting but gives silent 5s CD. Child modifier blocks targeting for Pelican/Shroud.
<size=105%>Fixes & Polish:</size>
- Universal Button Fix - Fixed Serial Killer, Bounty Hunter, Witch, etc. to correctly respect all shields.
- Shroud Ability - Secondary button now triggers a flash and 5s CD when hitting a shield.
- Assets - Restored original extension Vent Icons; optimized event priorities for protection logic.

News.SubTitle: Time Lord & UI Refresh
News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.0.3
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.3 - Time Lord & UI Refresh
★ MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH: Time Lord FINALLY WORKS! Full rework of physical position rewinding, revive thresholds, and game-breaking Pelican softlocks!
<size=105%>Role & Mechanics Changes:</size>
- Forestaller - Reworked guessability logic. Forestaller is now Guessable until all tasks are completed. Once tasks are done, they become Unguessable.

- Ventable Modifier - Overhauled Timer UI to use 0.0 precision. Fixed and enabled Uses Left counter with a dedicated vent sprite. Cooldown is now properly initialized at the start of the round and after meetings.

- Mirage Rework - Replaced random spawn with a Tablet selector. Decoy uses counter can now be set to infinity (shows infinity symbol and hides count). Provided a custom meeting feedback panel (like Lookout) with colorized roles.
<size=105%>Assassin & Guessing Polish:</size>
- Tablet UI Refresh - Implemented aggressive refresh for Mira/Tablet guessing screen. Players killed during meetings (e.g., via Death Note) are now immediately removed from the target list.
- FPS Optimization - optimized heavy update loops for Evoker, Charlatan, and Hacker to eliminate background FPS drops. Cached reflection results for dynamic UI rendering.
- Meeting FPS Optimization - throttled heavy Update routines in meetings (Witch, Pope, President) to resolve UI lag drop spikes.
- Classic Assassin Fix - Fixed visual bug where the guessing UI would 'stay' for non-guesser roles (e.g., Altruist).
- Bugfix - Fixed a potential soft-lock when opening the tablet while a player was being murdered.
<size=105%>Witch, Vampire Hunter & Lawyer Fixes:</size>
- Witch - fixed Curse Marker wallhack bug (now only visible during meetings). Cleaned up role markers upon death. Fixed misleading meeting countdown alerts.
- Name Colors - polished visibility logic: Impostors/Witch keep red names, others now immediately display hex tags and red names at meetings upon being cursed.
- Lawyer - fixed soft-lock where dead Lawyers wouldn't transition to fallback roles. Fully clears outdated relationship links to prevent game freeze.

- Vampire Hunter - added Officer to the list of potential roles to become after all Vampires are dead. Excluded Imitator from the list of roles eligible to become a Vampire Hunter. Hidden uses counter when set to infinite (0 max failed stakes). Fixed bug where Amnesiacs remembering VH or Imitators copying VH stayed stuck without living vampires.
- Vanisher & Wraith - optimized invisibility logic. Restored native, highly optimized Swooper appearance presets from Mira API to fix continuous micro-stutters.

- Shield Protections - Fixed Crew Killing roles (Sheriff, Vampire Hunter, etc.) not triggering shield responses. Hitting a shield now shows the flash, gives a cooldown penalty, and properly notifies the protection source (e.g., Bodyguard retaliation window). Vampire Hunter also avoids wasting charges on blocked shots.
- Pelican vs Time Lord - Fixed game-breaking interaction. Rewinding time now safely ejects all swallowed players from the Pelican's stomach instead of leaving them trapped and permanently invisible.
- Time Lord Revives - Fixed hardcoded revive cutoff issues. Rewind now strictly respects the Rewind History Seconds setting instead of erroneously reviving older dead players.

- Time Lord Physical Rewind - Overrode internal Mira API state tracking to forcefully clamp local position buffers. Physical movement rewind now strictly matches the configured lobby duration instead of resetting to the default 7.5s value.
- Impostor Friendly Fire - Fixed Poisoner being able to target, poison, or slow down allied Impostors and Crewpostors.
- Targeting Blocks - Fixed Outlaw, Witch, and Kamikaze single-target kills getting completely blocked when an allied player stands closer to the killer than a valid target.
- Draft UI Optimization - Greatly optimized Draft UI update logic, resolving background micro-stutters and providing silky smooth menu animations.

- Draft Spectator Fix - Fixed a critical game-breaking bug where having spectators in the lobby would cause a permanent black screen after the draft phase completed. Spectators are now properly initialized with a fallback role, allowing the game to transition smoothly to the intro phase.
- Better Sonar - added custom player head map pointers and arrow overlays directly toggleable in the Modifiers tab.
- Extended Wiki Previews - Sonar and Egotist Extended will properly outline all hidden options on the wiki page.
- Possible Vampire Hunter - completely hidden from the role setup list to prevent lobby setup confusion.
- Bodyguard Colors - Darkened base role color to premium deep sapphire, matching associated shield flash visuals.
- Wiki Colors - Universal modifiers now utilize gray file styling, while Death Note and Venomous strictly carry distinct alignments.
- Audio Overhaul - updated intro sounds for multiple roles (Bodyguard, Witch, Lawyer, Hacker, etc.) to better fit their thematic identities.
- Bugfix - Fixed a critical bug where Parasite taking control during Communications Sabotage would reveal Impostor names to Crewmates.

Version 1.0.4 - Stability & Explosive Fixes
<size=105%>UI & Nickname Stability:</size>
- Nickname Flickering - FIXED flickering of nicknames. All symbols (Lawyer, Pope, Death Note, Shroud) now use a stable, synchronized system.
- Death Note Symbol - FIXED missing square; changed target marker to a beautiful purple outlined heart (♡).
<size=105%>Role Fixes & Logic:</size>
- RC-XD - Reworked detonation: correctly kills up to 5 players (including teammates). FIXED logic blocks near dead bodies.
- Self-Kills - Verified that shields correctly protect (or don't) from misfire/sacrifice according to lobby settings.
<size=105%>Optimizations:</size>
- Lawyer & Pope - Optimized indicator logic to eliminate micro-stutters and removed redundant UI objects.
<size=105%>Hacker - Massive Jam Rework:</size>
- Contextual Feedback - Removed global notifications. Jam feedback is now integrated directly into the UI.
- Emergency Button - During Jam, the emergency meeting button is disabled and displays "SYSTEM JAMMED".
- Report Block - Report button is now visually disabled (greyed out) during Jam. Attempting to report is blocked without causing UI freezes.
- Portable Device - Hacker's portable device now works normally during Jam or Communications Sabotage, while others remain blocked.
<size=105%>UI, Symbols & Colors:</size>
- Symbol Stability - Fixed a bug where Lawyer and Bodyguard symbols were visible on everyone for ghosts. They now strictly follow their targets.
- Color Reorganization - Cleaned up and categorized all role colors in the codebase (Crew/Neutral/Impostor) for better maintainability.
- Evoker - Darkened base color to a more atmospheric Cobalt Blue.
- Injector - Individual effect notifications are now only visible to the Injector.

News.SubTitle: Stability & Shield Overhaul
News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.0.5
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.5 - Stability & Role Reworks
<size=105%>Shield System & Bodyguard Fixes:</size>

- DEFINITIVE Shield Fix - Fixed a critical issue where Sheriff and Officer could hit protected players without triggering any notifications or flashes. This was caused by hardcoded shield checks in the base Town of Us mod that we now successfully intercept.
- Centralized Shield Logic - Moved all shield hit processing (flashes, RPCs, cooldowns) to a unified ShieldUtils system, ensuring 100% consistency across all killing roles.
- Mirror-Style Flashes - Reworked the screen flash effect to match the official Mirrorcaster logic. It now uses a dedicated renderer for a cleaner, high-quality visual response.
- Bodyguard Retaliation - Fixed the retaliation window: Bodyguards now reliably receive alerts when their target is hit by Sheriff, Officer, or Vampire Hunter.
<size=105%>Role & Logic Reworks:</size>
- Serial Killer - Added progressive Maniac Timer Reduction option. The Maniac timer now decreases after each kill, with a configurable floor (limit).
- Vampire Hunter - Killing a Vampire now restores 1 stake charge instead of just not consuming one, preventing bugs with charge UI synchronization.
- Wraith Swoop - Swoop sound effect is now local only (only the Wraith hears it), preventing everyone on the map from knowing the Wraith's location.
- Poisoner - Removed the annoying 'banger' screen shake effect when poisoning players.
<size=105%>Stability & Fixes:</size>
- Imitator - Fixed UI buttons disappearing when players died mid-meeting.
- Pope - Synchronized win priority during Judgement to prevent desync wins.
- Forestaller - Fixed visibility in guesser menus based on task completion status.
- General - Optimized internal RPC handling and updated intro sounds for improved performance.
